dataset_name: AssureX Claim Engine Common Warranty Dataset
description: Structured claims and v5 status-tile cards with a prominent flags banner.

features.name: claim_id
features.description: Unique identifier assigned to each claim (e.g., CLM-2026-0001).

features.name: user_id
features.description: Unique identifier of claimant customer or service station.

features.name: product_id
features.description: Unique identifier of registered product under warranty.

features.name: product_name
features.description: Name of product model and brand.

features.name: product_category
features.description: Product warranty category.

features.name: brand
features.description: Manufacturer brand name.

features.name: model_number
features.description: Product model designation.

features.name: user_serial_number
features.description: Serial number provided by user.

features.name: ocr_serial_number
features.description: Serial number extracted via document OCR.

features.name: serial_match_status
features.description: Serial verification match status.

features.name: purchase_date
features.description: Date product was purchased.

features.name: purchase_price
features.description: Retail purchase price in USD.

features.name: retailer
features.description: Authorized merchant or store name.

features.name: warranty_duration_months
features.description: Total warranty coverage period in months.

features.name: warranty_start_date
features.description: Date warranty coverage starts. In this dataset it equals the purchase date.

features.name: warranty_expiry_date
features.description: Calculated end date of warranty coverage.

features.name: fault_occurrence_date
features.description: Date fault symptom was observed.

features.name: claim_submission_date
features.description: Date claim was submitted to engine.

features.name: fault_category
features.description: Reported fault defect category.

features.name: damage_type
features.description: Excluded physical damage type if any.

features.name: previous_repairs_count
features.description: Number of previous repair logs for this product.

features.name: has_unauthorized_repairs
features.description: Flag indicating unauthorized service attempts.

features.name: has_receipt
features.description: True if receipt invoice document attached.

features.name: has_warranty_card
features.description: True if warranty card attached.

features.name: has_product_photo
features.description: True if product damage photo attached.

features.name: has_serial_photo
features.description: True if serial number photo attached.

features.name: missing_documents_count
features.description: Total count of missing mandatory documents.

features.name: contradiction_flag
features.description: True if timeline contradiction detected.

features.name: duplicate_claim_flag
features.description: True if duplicate serial/hash detected.

features.name: product_age_days
features.description: Derived days between purchase and submission.

features.name: remaining_warranty_days
features.description: Derived days remaining in warranty coverage.

features.name: reporting_delay_days
features.description: Derived days between fault occurrence and submission.

features.name: actual_class
features.description: Ground truth adjudication label.
